title: CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.31938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy complete

translated_title: CAPE：协同校准与搜索的工具使用策略编译
translated_abstract: 即使工具调用背后的操作是正确的，该调用也可能失败，因为接收方工具会在代理无法查看的配置下解析分隔符、日期或记录布局。为此类工具编译工具使用策略既需要校准，即在候选配置上评估候选调用，也需要在已评估的调用上进行搜索。这两者共享同一个编译预算：如果先把所有内容都校准好，任何改进后的策略都要推迟到最后才能产生；而如果对每个部分已知的模型都重新求解，则会延误下一个有用的查询。一个调用只要在能够到达它的配置上的效果是已知的，它就可以被使用。基于这一观察，我们提出了CAPE，一个无需训练的编译器。它在任何时刻都保持一个可执行的策略，将校准引导至能够改进该策略的调用上，并且只在能够提前结束校准的情况下收紧边界。返回的策略保留了初始策略所完成的每一个配置。
tldr: CAPE是一个无需训练的工具使用策略编译器，它通过协调校准与搜索，始终保持可执行策略，并将校准资源集中于能改进该策略的调用上，从而高效应对配置不可见工具导致的调用失败问题。
en_tdlr: CAPE is a training-free compiler for tool-use policies that coordinates calibration and search, maintaining an executable policy at all times while directing calibration toward the calls that can improve it.
